message.text:
Checking whether memopayload.Runner is constructed and used in production. Determining whether MarkdownRenderer is part of the public interface or an internal helper.

The concrete implementation is `markdown.service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`. It is constructed by `markdown.NewService` inside `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`. The interface lives in `APIV1Service.MarkdownService`, which receives the same instance as `RSSService.MarkdownService`.

`memopayload.Runner` holds a `MarkdownService` field, yet it is never instantiated in production; `RebuildMemoPayload` instead receives the service directly from `APIV1Service`. Internally, `service` delegates to `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` for rendering and renaming, but that renderer is a helper, not part of the public interface.

The markdown processing interface is `markdown.Service` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`.

The only concrete implementation is an unexported `service` struct returned by `markdown.NewService()`. It is constructed by `NewAPIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`, and by `test_helper.go` in tests. The interface is held by `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`. An internal helper, `renderer.MarkdownRenderer`, is used inside `service.RenderMarkdown` and `service.RenameTag`; it is instantiated locally via `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` each call.

`RSSService.MarkdownService` holds the shared instance from `server.go:85`. `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` is declared but never wired in production; `RebuildMemoPayload` accepts the interface as a parameter instead. The interface is held by `APIV1Service` and `RSSService` as fields, while `memopayload.Runner` only declares the type.
